name: manuscript-studio
description: Shared manuscript preparation and literary workflows for editing, translation, formatting, querying, and approval.

interface.longDescription: Prepare verified chapter Markdown, assess and edit literary manuscripts, translate Chinese-English prose, and develop literary-agent query materials with author-controlled approvals. Formatting requires an available Documents skill, rendering tools, and page inspection; otherwise generation is blocked and the formatting specification is retained. Interactive reviews require a Codex-compatible inline visualization surface; other environments use revision-bound text decisions. File access, Python, dependencies, and web research depend on the host. See the runtime support guide linked from the project website.
defaultPrompt: Assess my manuscript and propose edits for my approval.
Translate my literary manuscript while preserving its voice.
Format my manuscript as a Word edition with a table of contents.
